name: Feeds Crawler Fetcher
description: Adds a Feeds fetcher that crawls a set of URLs (server-side HTTP). Feed sources are admin-configured, but because it fetches URLs from the server, treat the URL list as trusted and be aware of SSRF if any URL is user-influenced.
project_description:
This module will create an additional Feeds Fetcher that crawls and fetch a set of URL, allowing the Feeds to import from more than one source. This is helpful if you want to import a paged source. 

 Post-Installation 
 After install, create a new Feeds Type and select "Crawl a set of url" Fetcher type.

Configure the Feeds mapping as usual.

After configuration, add a new Feeds, and add one or several URL's to the textarea, one in each line.

Import the Feeds

 Atention 

This module is in development! Currently, it only works with XML/HTML sources. (see https://www.drupal.org/project/feeds_ex )
